scientific_stage: M2-A public-I1-only compatibility confirmation before any graph composition

screening_rule.alternative_selection: Starting from the frozen M1-v2 surrogate, greedily add the candidate maximizing its minimum Euclidean distance to the already selected set. Break ties by lower search MSE, then lower trial number, then source path.
screening_rule.rationale: A single uniform 1.25x local-search-MSE ceiling is the first inspected predefined band that contains at least three candidates for every provider. It preserves a common public-I1-only compatibility ceiling while leaving visible parameter diversity in all three providers.

confirmation.purpose: Reduce 25-trajectory search noise and freeze the locally compatible M2-A candidate set. Confirmation uses only the public I1 surface.

stop_rule: If any provider has fewer than two confirmation-compatible candidates, stop M2-A before graph composition. Do not automatically widen the loss ceiling. Revisit the local-I1-only rule explicitly.
